extracted.intended_audience: prospective NDSEG fellowship applicants (graduate students applying to the DoD NDSEG fellowship)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit a complete NDSEG Fellowship application packet (personal statement, research proposal, transcripts, and reference evaluation forms) that follows formatting, anonymity, and content rules and aligns with Department of Defense BAA topics. The page defines required components, formatting limits, prohibitions on identifying information, and the evaluation weighting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission & completeness requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: An NDSEG Fellowship application must be submitted electronically to qualify for consideration. All application sections, including references, must be completed before an applicant can submit the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications that have not been submitted are considered incomplete and will not be reviewed. No application items will be accepted after the deadline. If an application does not contain all required elements it will not be reviewed; it is the applicant's responsibility to ensure completeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required application components
rubrics_metrics.description: A complete fellowship application consists of: a contractor provided application form (contact info, demographic info, field of study, proposed research relevance to DoD), a proposed DoD sponsoring agency and research technical discipline area, official undergraduate transcript(s), and three contractor provided Reference Evaluation Forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep in mind any agency can choose to make an award based on your application. If submitting four references you must DELETE ONE reference before submission so that three are recorded. Separate letters on letterhead will NOT be accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anonymity / identifying information prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not reference your name, school name, advisor name, or anything that denotes who you are and what school you attend in the Personal Statement, Research Proposal, or Reference forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This prohibition is repeated for Personal Statement, Research Proposal, and Reference Evaluation Forms. Use of identifying information in references or application materials can lead to disqualification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal statement content and format
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement will be typed in a Form (500 words).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No special formatting required. Address: What are your short and long-term professional goals? How did these goals develop? How have you already begun to lay the foundation for these goals? How does this fellowship fit into these goals? Keep in mind personal statements are your introduction to the reviewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference evaluation forms requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Three Reference Evaluation Forms are required (four can be submitted but one must be deleted before submission). Recommenders must complete the contractor-provided reference link; separate letters on letterhead will NOT be accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References should be provided by academic advisors, research advisors, internship supervisors, mentors, teachers, or employers. If other reference types are provided you must indicate the type (Educational, Personal, Mentor, Clergy, etc.). Recommenders must NOT use the university's name, the applicant's name, or the professor's name in any written response within the reference form or the applicant will be DISQUALIFIED. All references must be submitted by the stated deadline (example: Oct 31, 2022 at 11:59 PM). Applicants are advised to remind recommenders and log into the system periodically to ensure references have been submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transcripts: official copy and upload rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Official undergraduate transcript(s) must be uploaded as a PDF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do NOT mail or email transcripts to ITS-JV/NDSEG. Have an official copy mailed or emailed to you and upload into the application. When downloading a PDF (transcripts, GREs), be sure to open the file and save properly before uploading. Preview files before uploading and final submission. For first semester of graduate school, place a '0.0' for the GPA and upload your coursework or acceptance letter for the transcript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research proposal content alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Research should align with one or more specific topics under the Department of Defense's Broad Agency Announcements (BAAs), but you are not submitting a proposal to that announcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The research proposal should capture how well the proposal responds to one of the BAAs listed on the website under the DOD menu. BAAs are provided as a guide to DoD research interest; expired BAAs should not be used for the Air Force, though Army and Navy BAAs will be updated. Applicants may use expired research projects for topics if the overall research won't change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research proposal formatting and file rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Proposal: 3 Page Proposal single line space; 1 Page Max Cited Works (to be uploaded separately). Total Proposal and cited work = 4 pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Graphics and charts may be included. Use 11 pt Times New Roman font (a smaller font size may be used for cited work, charts and graphics). Margins should be 1 inch. Upload the research proposal using the required file name format (example: '2023-RP-Initials-Abreviated Discipline' e.g., '2023-RP-KYM-CHEM-ENG'). If uploading a new file (replacing an old file) you must use a unique name each time (e.g., add '-2'). Name the works-cited file 'Works-Cited-Initials' and increment if replacing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation weighting / selection criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation and Selection is broken down by weighted criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed research relevant to the DoD — 65%; Academic Experience and Accomplishments — 10%; Reference Evaluation Forms — 15%; Personal Statement — 10%.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants should not contact Program Officers listed under the BAAs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All questions should be directed to ITS (ndseg@its-jv.com). At no time should an applicant reach out to the Program Officers listed under the BAAs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application editing and deadline policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants can make changes to their application until official submission or the application closing date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upon application closing, incomplete applications will be discarded. There will be no further applications or materials accepted for consideration after the application deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative/file-handling and application pointers
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical advice to avoid upload/submission problems and improve application quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have an advisor review your Proposal and Personal Statement. Log into the system periodically to ensure references have been submitted. When downloading and re-uploading PDFs, open and save properly before uploading. Preview files before final submission.
